name: @vaipakam/rpc-proxy
description: Read-only JSON-RPC proxy for the connected app (#1724). Holds each chain's provider URL as a Worker secret so no API key ships in the browser bundle, and forwards only the reads the app makes (method allowlist, bounded eth_getLogs, origin check, per-IP rate limit). Holds no signing key and forwards no transaction. Off by default: nothing deploys it until an operator creates its secrets and deploys it.
